<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Protests and political rhetoric:</strong> The BJP has criticized opposition-led protests against the Election Commission, asserting that India is governed by Parliament rather than street demonstrations, while Rahul Gandhi has challenged the government to arrest opposition leaders.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPYWk1SHJTX1d3cEJBSUpJWmI3cFNlRVk2MmdNa1J2SzZJc2owTnBuZmxyRUlNeFZTdWZzak1reFlyN1F6aGt4S19aalpvcG0zMHc4QzBtZzBRYnZDQnVhRUh0eGJwU2NXdVZDaVFKWFBTMGFwaTk3M21rYnc3UDBJRDEtWXN5TE1MajdDbnk3ZXpnQ0RjWU5tVFpoUVRZTXZPNUhEcHpUVGxiSVhvU1FrNkhzaWtnOXBQR1dpbmVB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPNG9zLVVtQ1A3bUNpOVd0ZXlaVXZCQlp2clpYUldUeWdVYUh1Z0FYTEpTUjVPUVYxUk5IWnFRREFPOW4yUXozeFZJWVdaOFlQc1lsRUg1aWNFaDgtU0ZzYnVDdC16Y3JjSHpacEdwdjMxdEZwdEtzd3NtcE4xOHdVYnYycXotaUlGTVVsYVVCaXJIYXMtVDFNTEJORVNuY2FUMGtxRWlxVlBfS0RBTlg4bUM0Sks?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges ECI:</strong> The INDIA bloc has formally approached the President regarding alleged poll rigging and is planning to move the Supreme Court to address concerns over voting rights and the conduct of the Chief Election Commissioner.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral and judicial developments:</strong> The Supreme Court has reserved judgment on the interpretation of Section 151A of the RP Act regarding the Election Commission&#x27;s discretion to skip bye-elections, while the BJP secured a significant victory by winning Assam’s Nagaon Lok Sabha seat.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9QdXFzR2dxWVpybE5lQ2RkYmNxb3MtU0tMSWRnUEtwZkZmRWdIQVdtTnBXMmFsVlhyaUxQbzlvUjZqcl8xbUYzNjNuMmZ3allZZHB1bVZka1l6MGRYbE9DSkZlRVdCLTZObFU3ZGZIQ0hEcnJMQzgw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Governance and infrastructure:</strong> The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved renaming the Noida International Airport to &quot;Narendra Modi International Airport,&quot; coinciding with celebrations of the Prime Minister&#x27;s 25 years in public service.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPSnk4Y1lja2tHOVp0cTk3MG9WRzdVNmZLN0lZbng3aEo2Z1p0R0F6MHNUQm16RFloOTJoNnNfZmdINXEwaGNyeFNITlQ4UW5uNjR5Q3Izem0zWm5hRlpwZUw3M3NSYzhna1R5QzE5MzVzWW9ZenZWbnlrVUpZMllReURMd2dWbTVlZmIxc1ZkMlRSZlRTSEJYVVVOTVNpQnRTNGRkVWxuN01WYXRrSkhQZ0VFUnFCcXJOT3ctRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFBlWDVabWQ3Z3h6anVFRnZ3NHlOY0JQZlRxQjJuQUp3c19WdlZOT1paOW04ZWNLbl9fcEVobHlNd1B6N0lxdGdsUUNWOGJTYjNIdWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court is set to examine the Election Commission&#x27;s powers under Article 324 following controversies surrounding Form 6, as youth groups continue to stage demonstrations demanding the removal of the Chief Election Commissioner.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
</ul>
